assessment.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v oblasti Rudého moře a Hormuzského průlivu zůstává kritická kvůli nedávným americkým úderům na íránské pozice na ostrově Qeshm a probíhajícím pozemním střetům v Jemenu. Hrozba pro energetickou infrastrukturu a námořní dopravu nadále eskaluje navzdory probíhajícím diplomatickým jednáním.
assessment.security_status_en: The security situation in the Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz remains critical due to recent U.S. strikes on Iranian positions on Qeshm Island and ongoing ground clashes in Yemen. Threats to energy infrastructure and maritime shipping continue to escalate despite ongoing diplomatic talks.

recommendations.reason_cs: Přetrvávající napětí v Hormuzském průlivu a nutnost objíždět rizikové oblasti udržují vysoké sazby za námořní přepravu.
recommendations.reason_en: Persistent tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and the need to bypass high-risk areas keep freight rates elevated.

recommendations.reason_en: Oil prices remain highly volatile and sensitive to reports of strikes in the Strait of Hormuz, supporting strong margins for producers.

recommendations.sector_cs: Evropský Spotřební sektor & Autoprůmysl (např. Volvo, BMW)

recommendations.reason_en: Rising energy costs and potential supply chain delays through the Suez Canal negatively impact profit margins.

recommendations.reason_en: Domestic equities show resilience, but global macroeconomic uncertainty and interest rate trends limit significant upside potential.

recommendations.reason_en: Mixed influences include strong positioning for energy and defense firms, though broader market sentiment is dampened by economic slowdown fears.

assessment.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na trzích s ropou a v přepravních sazbách v závislosti na reakci Íránu na americké údere. Bezpečnostní situace v Rudém moři a kolem Hormuzského průlivu zůstane vysoce napjatá.
assessment.forecast_en: Continued volatility in oil markets and shipping rates is expected over the coming days, depending on Iran's response to U.S. strikes. The security situation in the Red Sea and around the Strait of Hormuz will remain highly tense.
assessment.forecast_review_cs: Předchozí předpověď se potvrdila, neboť trhy reagovaly na americké volby a zprávy z oblasti Hormuzského průlivu a Jemenu přesně v duchu očekávané volatility.
assessment.forecast_review_en: The previous forecast was confirmed, as markets reacted to the U.S. elections and reports from the Strait of Hormuz and Yemen precisely in line with anticipated volatility.

The internationally recognised Yemeni government says its troops have recaptured positions from Houthi forces in Lahij governorate, located south-west of the country.

"Our armed forces have succeeded in recapturing positions in the al-Khazzan al-Ahmar area on the al-Nusayrah front in the al-Sawalihah sub-district of the al-Maqatirah district in northern Lahij governorate, and have repelled the terrorist Houthi militias" the government forces' media centre said.

Yemeni army says it launched nearly 1,000 operations against Houthi targets over past day

The Yemeni army said that it launched 951 operations targeting Houthi positions over the past 24 hours as part of Operation Dawn of Yemen.

Army spokesperson Majed al-Nuzaili claimed in a post on X that the operations had "neutralized" around 332 Houthi field commanders and fighters.

Moreover, the army claimed to have destroyed or damaged 56 vehicles, pieces of equipment and weapons across several fronts, including Al-Jawf, Marib and Al-Bayda.

articles.summary:
Yemeni government forces launch strikes on Houthi positions west of Taiz

Forces belonging to Yemen’s internationally recognised government have carried out air strikes against Houthi positions west of Taiz.

The military spokesperson said that warplanes targeted the movement's military vehicles in the Jabal Habashi area, resulting in the killing of Houthi fighters. 

Meanwhile, Houthi-affiliated media reported that a strike north of Taiz targeted a plastic shoe factory, killing three and injuring eight others.

articles.title: Report: US launched strikes on Iran
articles.summary:
Report: US launched strikes on Iran

The US military is responsible for strikes on Iran, according to The Wall Street Journal citing an unnamed US official. 

The newspaper indicated that the attacks were part of a series of limited operations Washington had "secretly carried out" against the country. 

Earlier, several explosions were heard in southern Iran's  Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz as well as in the coastal city of Bandar Lengeh in Hormozgan province.

The strikes come despite US president Donald Trump's remarks saying he would not launch attacks against Iran after the midterms.

Brent crude drops by more than 6% to $105.55 a barrel, the lowest level in more than two weeks

The oil price has fallen to its lowest level in more two weeks amid new hopes of a breakthrough to end the Iran war.

Brent crude, the international benchmark, dropped by more than 6.5% to as low as $105.55 a barrel on Monday, the lowest since 16 October, sending shares in airline companies higher and pushing down government borrowing costs.

archive.forecast_en: Continued oil price volatility and market nervousness are expected in the coming days, heavily dependent on the trajectory of diplomatic talks in Doha and escalation in the Strait of Hormuz. Security risks along maritime routes will remain at a critical level.

archive.forecast_en: Volatility tied to the US midterm election outcome and Washington's response to Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz is expected in the coming days. The security situation in the Red Sea and Yemen will remain highly unstable.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v oblasti Rudého moře a Hormuzského průlivu zůstává kritická kvůli nedávným americkým úderům na íránské pozice na ostrově Qeshm a probíhajícím pozemním střetům v Jemenu. archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz remains critical due to recent U.S. strikes on Iranian positions on Qeshm Island and ongoing ground clashes in Yemen. archive.forecast_en: Continued volatility in oil markets and shipping rates is expected over the coming days, depending on Iran's response to U.S. strikes. The security situation in the Red Sea and around the Strait of Hormuz will remain highly tense.
